messages:
olivia: Heads-up — several EU customers have ~2x token usage on today's invoices vs telemetry. Noticed at ~08:10 PST, billing spikes look like duplicate events. Anyone on call for metering?

sam: saw the spike in dashboards, opening the raw event stream now. looks like the attribution pipeline got a fanout change merged yesterday. suspect double-write from the new consumer.

kevin: confirmed — in kafka consumer group `attribution-v2` there are two different instances (v2 and legacy shadow) both writing to `billing.events` for the same request ids. patch in PR #322 enabled parallel writers for rollout.

maria: oof. that rollout was meant to be canary-only, not dual-writer. we used feature flag but forgot the single-writer enforcement in the producer.

olivia: @kevin can you paste the query that shows duplicates? need sample request_id list to reconcile invoices.

kevin: sure, quick query: ```SELECT request_id, count(*) AS writes FROM billing.events WHERE ts >= '2024-04-10' AND region = 'eu' GROUP BY request_id HAVING writes > 1 LIMIT 20;``` results show same request_id with different event_id and same token_count.

sam: that matches the customer complaints. Looks like downstream invoice generation doesn't dedupe on request_id, just consumes all events.

maria: immediately rolling the canary back to single writer. also adding a streaming middleware that sets `idempotency_key = sha256(request_id + producer_id)` so duplicate writes can be filtered.

metering-bot: :warning: Alert 45: duplicate_billing_events_detected (eu) — 143 duplicates in last 1h. Pipeline: attribution-v2.

tj: short-term mitigation — add a dedupe step in the billing writer that ignores events with previously seen `request_id` within a 24h TTL. long-term we should centralize single-writer guarantee (leader election / partition ownership).

devex-jack: Can we expose a console flag so customers can see "dedupe applied" on their invoice details? would be helpful for support conversations. maybe a UI note and a CSV export column.

olivia: yes please. support needs an audit trail. add `dedupe_applied` boolean to invoice line items and surface in the billing UI + raw export. also we need an internal metric gauge `billing.deduped_events` for monitoring.

kevin: implementing dedupe in writer now, will backfill a reconciliation job that marks affected invoices and emits correction events. plan: avoid reprocessing by writing correction events rather than rewriting invoices.

sam: checklist: 1) rollback dual-writer (maria) 2) writer dedupe (kevin) 3) reconciliation job + support export (kevin/devex-jack) 4) add canary gating for any multi-consumer writes (tj) 5) update runbooks and add dashboard panels for `billing.deduped_events` (olivia). I'll own the postmortem.

maria: rollback done, feature-flag off, canary reverted. monitoring shows duplicates rate dropping.

olivia: great. assign follow-ups in Asana? support needs a short blurb for customers affected.

devex-jack: will draft messaging and a console tooltip about dedupe. +1 on CSV column.

sam: leaving trace snippets in the thread: kafka offsets we saw: `partition 12 @ offset 1045234` duplicate writes from consumer ids `attr-v2-1` and `attr-shadow-2024-04-09`. keep logs for 48h.

kevin: PRs incoming — writer dedupe + schema bump adding `dedupe_applied` (backwards compatible). will include migration plan for invoice exports.

olivia: thanks team. postmortem expected EOD, include timeline and mitigation steps. :thumbsup:
